key.description: Optional and not read by Studio; a dubbing track returned by `GET` has none, so it can be sent back unchanged. Studio's editor writes `${id}_${language}_${source}_${dubbing}`.

words.description: Word-level text and timings. **Source of truth** for both subtitle rendering and dubbing text-to-speech. Must be non-empty: a segment submitted with an empty `words` array is dropped the next time the track is read (and produces no dubbing audio). To change a segment's content, edit these entries — not `text`. **Inline styling:** put `…`, `…` or `…` around text inside `word` to make it bold, italic or underlined, for example `really`. A style that spans several words opens in the first word and closes in the last. Keep the tags balanced within a segment and do not change `time_begin` or `time_end` when you only add or remove a style. The tags stay in SRT and VTT exports and are rendered in burned-in subtitles; they are removed for dubbing and for plain-text exports.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for the segment

text.description: Human-readable mirror of the segment text. **Not authoritative** — it is ignored when rendering subtitles or synthesizing dubbing audio, both of which are derived from `words`. Editing `text` alone has no effect on the output; change `words` instead (and keep `text` in sync for readability).

metadata.description: Review state and per-segment dubbing settings

cue_settings.description: Optional position of this segment's subtitle on the video. Omit it to use the position of the subtitle profile; a segment sent without `cue_settings` loses the position it had.

style.description: Optional style of this segment's subtitle, overriding the subtitle profile (font, size, colors, background, position). Omit it to use the subtitle profile; a segment sent without `style` loses the style it had.

comments.description: Reviewer comments of the segment (at most 200). **Omit the field to keep the comments stored in Studio** for this segment. Send an array to replace them: a comment that is not in the array is deleted, and an empty array deletes all of them. To add a comment, send the current ones plus the new one; to resolve one, send it with `resolved: true`. Comments belong to subtitle tracks (source and translation), not to dubbing tracks.
